intent.proves: Products stand in at least one workflow state that exists.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductWorkflowStateId) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WorkflowState s WHERE s.WorkflowStateId = p.ProductWorkflowStateId)
